# login-return-query

readReturnPath(search) returns the first return parameter, decoded exactly once using URLSearchParams form-query rules; no return parameter yields null. Preserve an empty value, literal percent signs after decoding, and any still-encoded text. This function only reads text; it does not authorize or follow redirects.

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`. Keep the public API and tests/ unchanged. Use Node built-ins only; no packages or network.
